open_slots_query.sql:
SELECT stay_start, stay_end, site_id, campsite, room_count,
       type_id, type_name, max_occupancy, parent_id
FROM (
  SELECT w.stay_start, w.stay_end, a.site_id, c.name AS campsite,
         MIN(a.room_count) AS room_count, at.id AS type_id,
         at.name AS type_name, at.max_occupancy, c.parent_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY w.stay_start, w.stay_end ORDER BY at.id
         ) AS rn
  FROM unnest(ARRAY['2026-09-22', '2026-09-23', '2026-09-24', '2026-09-25', '2026-09-26', '2026-09-27']::date[], ARRAY['2026-09-23', '2026-09-24', '2026-09-25', '2026-09-26', '2026-09-27', '2026-09-28']::date[], ARRAY[1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]::int[])
    AS w(stay_start, stay_end, night_count)
  JOIN availability a
    ON a.start_date >= w.stay_start
   AND a.start_date < w.stay_end
   AND a.end_date = a.start_date + 1
  JOIN accommodation_types at ON at.id = a.accommodation_type_id
  JOIN campsites c ON c.id = a.site_id
  WHERE (at.max_occupancy IS NULL OR at.max_occupancy >= 4)
  GROUP BY w.stay_start, w.stay_end, w.night_count,
           a.site_id, c.name, at.id, at.name, at.max_occupancy,
           c.parent_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.start_date) = w.night_count
) q
WHERE rn <= 80
ORDER BY stay_start, type_id
